news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.89 (vs ₹4.65 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.89 (up from ₹4.65 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹104.8b (up 12% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹5.44b (up 28% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 5.2% (up from 4.5% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Insurance industry in India.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Of these new board members, 2 were independent directors. The company's board is composed of: 4 independent directors. 5 non-independent directors. Independent Director Mukul Gupta was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Lack of board continuity.
